subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: What received-value disclosure contract should `openclaw config validate` use for invalid core and plugin-owned fields?
rationale: Fixing the effective-value bug can expose environment-substituted contents, while the current path classifier cannot by itself define the permanent safety contract for arbitrary plugin schemas.

options.title: Require explicit safe metadata
options.body: Render effective received values only when the validation issue or owning schema explicitly marks the field safe for diagnostic disclosure.

options.title: Keep classifier-based output
options.body: Continue showing every non-SecretRef value whose path is not classified as sensitive, accepting responsibility for maintaining comprehensive core and plugin path detection.

options.title: Omit received values
options.body: Land line numbers and bracket paths but remove received-value hints until a typed redaction contract exists.

recommendation.title: Require explicit safe metadata
recommendation.body: Render effective received values only when the validation issue or owning schema explicitly marks the field safe for diagnostic disclosure.

likelyOwner.reason: Their broad recent ownership across config loading, CLI behavior, and integration history makes them the best available decision owner. ([github.com](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commits/main/src/config/io.ts))
